name: Shinomiya Kojiro
source:
Owner of a French cuisine restaurant called Shino's, Koujirou was a student of the 79th generation and held the first seat in the Council of Ten Masters, he is a man with glasses and red hair. He is also known as the "Legumes Magician". 

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Food_Wars:_Shokugeki_no_Soma_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
